decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build directly on the firm’s dental materials and custom-device knowledge, and in-house R&D can interpret early results to improve them.
PETG thermoforming blanks draw on the firm’s materials and dental-lab workflow expertise, allowing it to assimilate feedback and refine the product.
UV-curing lacquer, though more chemistry-intensive, still fits the firm’s materials R&D and certified quality systems, providing enough related knowledge to learn and improve it.
Custom hearing protection earmolds are directly aligned with the firm’s hearing-care channels and custom-manufacturing capabilities, making them highly related and likely to be retained.
